title: Org roles onboarding flow + compact audit viewport
body:
Purpose:
- Capture a minimal, developer-friendly onboarding flow for creating an org/team and assigning initial roles + API credentials.
- Design a compact audit viewport that surfaces relevant security and operational events without overwhelming new users.
- Surface clear microcopy and default choices to reduce support tickets.

Scope / Constraints: 
- Should work for Hosted and Dedicated customers; Private may have stricter KMS flows (out of scope for this sketch, but callouts included).
- Must preserve ability to create user API keys and service accounts; differentiate UX to reduce accidental key leaks.

High-level goals:
1) New org setup: 3-step flow (Org info -> Invite users & set roles -> Create initial key & review audit view)
2) Role defaults: Provide recommended starter roles for small teams (Owner, Admin, Developer, Viewer) with one-click role bundles.
3) API key surface: Stronger affordances for short-lived keys and service accounts (TTL, scopes).
4) Compact audit viewport: timeline + prioritized events + quick filters (keys, sign-ins, role changes).

Flow sketch (stepwise):
- Step 0: Landing / CTA -> "Create org" (CTA text: "Create team and get API key")
- Step 1: Org basics (name, billing contact optional) -> Next
- Step 2: Invite users (email entry + suggested role dropdown). UI detail: inline role helper text: "Dev = call & debug; Viewer = dashboard only"
  - Bulk invite textarea (CSV paste) + inline validation for common typos (gmail vs example.com mismatch)
  - Suggested package: Add "First user as Owner" checkbox when single user invited.
- Step 3: Choose credential path: Developer keys (user-scoped) OR Service account (machine/scoped).
  - Big button choice: "Create service account (recommended for servers)" and "Create user API key (quick testing)"
  - When service account chosen: show default scopes toggle (read-only embeddings, generate text) + key TTL slider (1h / 1d / 7d / unlimited) + HSM/KMS toggle note for Private customers
  - When user key chosen: warn about long-lived keys and show suggestion to enable session-based keys or Key Rotation schedule.
- Step 4: Review & create -> Summary card listing invited people, assigned roles, credential type + link to audit preview

Audit viewport (compact) concept: goal is to make the audit view useful during onboarding review and ongoing ops without being a full SRE page.
- Top row: summary badges (past 7d): active keys, failed auths, role changes, high-risk events
- Middle: prioritized feed (most relevant first) with event tags + brief description + small context pill (actor, target, time)
- Right rail: quick filters (event type), saved queries, export 

Sample compact event entries (short lines):
[ICON] Role change · Sara M. promoted to Admin · by Claire Z · 10m ago
[ICON] API key created · svc-account-lexi · scope=generate,embeddings · TTL=7d · 2h ago
[WARN ICON] Failed sign-in · 3x from 198.51.100.22 · 1h ago
[INFO ICON] Billing contact added · billing@acme.com · 3d ago

Wireframe ASCII (very rough) for audit viewport: 
------------------------------------------------------------
| Badges: [Active keys 4] [Failed sign-ins 2] [Role changes 6] |
|----------------------------------------------------------|
| Filter: [All v] [Keys v] [Auth v] [Roles v]  Search: [____] |
|----------------------------------------------------------|
| • Role change · Sara M. -> Admin       · Claire Z · 10m ago |
| • API key created · svc-lexi            ·  generate  · 2h  |
| • Failed sign-in · 3x from 198.51.100.22 ·  1h ago         |
| • PR review webhook added                · infra-bot · 2d  |
|----------------------------------------------------------|
| Quick actions: [Revoke key] [Open session logs] [Export]    |
------------------------------------------------------------

Microcopy and safety hints:
- When creating a key: show short explainer: "Prefer service accounts for server workloads — choose short TTLs and limit scopes."
- When inviting users: "Owners can remove other owners. Use Admin for day-to-day permissions."
- If user tries to create unlimited TTL key, show modal: "This key will not expire automatically. Consider rotation policies. Proceed?"

Accessibility + mobile considerations:
- Compact feed uses 1-col stack on narrow widths; filters collapse into an accordion.
- Ensure badges have textual equivalents and icons have alt text.

Acceptance criteria / TODOs for PM + Eng grooming:
- [ ] Prototype clickable mock in Figma for all steps (owner: Marco)
- [ ] Implement API for role bundles + suggested defaults (backend: auth-service, ticket JIRA-CORE-4123)
- [ ] Audit feed endpoint with prioritized events and feed pagination (SRE/observability)
- [ ] Key creation modal: TTL and scope enforcement; enforce org-level policy if set
- [ ] Add telemetry points: created_org, invited_user, key_created(type, ttl, scope)

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Should we auto-provision a default service account for infra pipelines? (pros: less friction; cons: accidental long-lived keys)
- Do we force short default TTL for all hosted orgs? If so, how to handle CI workflows?
- Which events are considered "high-risk" and bubble to top? Role changes, key creation, export of audit logs? Need SRE/product discussion.

Backlog items (rough priority):
- P0: Figma prototype + review (JIRA-UX-7201)
- P1: Backend bundle API + default role sets (JIRA-AUTH-334)
- P1: Audit feed API + compact query (JIRA-OBS-212)
- P2: Key rotation UI + alerting for long-lived keys (JIRA-SEC-607)

Notes / references: 
- Related designs: CONFLUENCE-ORG/roles-onboarding-v1 (high level background)
- Look at competitor surfaces: (note) smaller SaaS vendors put TTL slider directly on create modal — helps reduce support.
- Past support tickets: #SUP-1192 (customer accidentally used user key in prod), #SUP-1286 (confused by audit noise)

Next steps for this doc:
- Add Figma link and embed early prototype screenshots once Marco uploads.
- Run quick usability test with 3 internal devs (Sana to schedule).
- Lock down microcopy for key modal and invite flows (owner: Claire)

Unresolved copy stubs to finalize: 
- CTA on org creation page (A/B test: "Create a team and get started" vs "Create team and get API key")
- Short help text for role bundles naming (Owner / Admin / Developer / Viewer)

Rough estimate of effort: 3 sprints (design + backend + audit infra) to get an MVP that covers Hosted and Dedicated. Private will require extra KMS/HSM knobs (add-on sprint).

----
Changelog: 
- 2024-11-12 initial draft by Claire (this doc)
- 2024-11-20 added audit viewport sketch and backlog items (Sana)
- 2024-12-02 minor copy edits and added Jira refs (Marco)

Notes to self: keep onboarding short; default to safer defaults.
